name: Aim and Shoot
tagline: You aim. The robots learn. One arena, with your friends.
description:
You are the black one with the blue ring. Move, aim, shoot the robots before they shoot you. Each wave the survivors breed: they get better at dodging, better at hitting, better at not walking into the walls — which hurt you too. Your best generation is saved.

Press Invite in the bar above and whoever opens the link stands in the SAME arena: one wave, one set of robots, everyone on the same side. Your shots pass through your friends, the robots shoot at all of you, and going down puts you on the floor for a few seconds rather than ending the run — that only happens when the whole team is down at once.

On a computer, WASD or arrows to move, the mouse to aim, click to fire. On a phone a stick on the left moves you, a drag on the right aims, and FIRE sits under the right thumb. Tap the title art to start.

An unofficial port of Aim and Shoot by Victor Ribeiro, a neuroevolution experiment. The bots, the gun, and the joke about Nole Ksum are his.
